{"parentUuid":null,"isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"Design the implementation plan for the EXTENSIONS of a SIGIL 'phone companion': (A) the phone as a remote GESTURE TRACKPAD (streams hand landmarks to the PC), (B) DEVICE-SIGNED REMOTE ARM of a gesture session (the owner explicitly wants a phone to be able to arm a session remotely — a trust-widening), (C) remote 'what did I last see' RECALL, (D) a mobile-OS BACKEND, and (E) fixing a latent security gap. Repo: /home/kali/sigil (local-first, offense-free personal AI orchestrator; doctrine: append-only signed spine, fail-closed WARDEN tiers A0-A3, prove-don't-guess, no offense). This rides on a bridge HTTP transport being built in a parallel workstream (a WireGuard-bound server wrapping BridgeDaemon + a device-signed request envelope). Output a detailed slice-by-slice plan; name files + reuse points. Do NOT write code — design only.\n\nGROUND TRUTH from exploration (verified):\n- GESTURE PIPELINE is fully decoupled via injectable seams. `sigil/gesture/run.py` `run_gesture(*, store, owner_key, source, landmarker, classifier, backend, pipeline, gate, max_frames)` loop body: `reading = classifier.classify(landmarker.detect(frame)); intent = pipeline.on_frame(reading); if intent: gate.handle(intent)`. All components constructor-injectable.\n- SEAMS for a phone: `sigil/gesture/components.py` Protocols — `LandmarkModel{egresses:bool; detect(image)->List[Hand]}`, `GestureModel{classify(hands)->GestureReading}`. `Hand` (`gesture/types.py`) is a frozen dataclass: `landmarks: Tuple[Tuple[float,float,float],...]` (21 (x,y,z)), `handedness`, `score` — TINY + serializable. The cheapest phone-input path ('Option B') is: phone runs on-device landmark detection (e.g. MediaPipe) and STREAMS `List[Hand]` to the PC; the PC feeds them through a landmarker-shaped seam that ignores `image` and returns the remote Hands. This SIDESTEPS the inert on-box `OnnxHandLandmarker` (no bundled model → detect()->[]). The REAL `RuleClassifier` (features.py) + `GesturePipeline` FSM + `SessionGate` work unchanged.\n- `sigil/gesture/pipeline.py` `GesturePipeline` — debounced fail-safe FSM (confirm_frames, cooldown, hand_lost_frames→GestureIntent('hand_lost'), conf_min, margin_min, deadzone). DISCRETE map pinch→click, swipe→scroll, spread→launch, twofinger→type, grab→drag; point→continuous move.\n- `sigil/gesture/session.py` `SessionGate(store, backend, *, classifier, owner_key)` — THE KEYSTONE. `arm(*, owner_key, ttl_seconds=1800)` REQUIRES the owner key in-process (RuntimeError without it), appends a SIGNED `gesture.session_armed` record (signed_payload over core with owner Ed25519), TTL-bounded, live Session in memory. `disarm()` appends `gesture.session_disarmed`. `handle(intent)->dict`: hand_lost→disarm; no/expired session→refuse; else tier from WARDEN via `INTENT_TOOL` map; tier<=A1→_inject (pointer move/click/scroll/drag) [+log discrete; per-frame move is telemetry-only]; A2+→QUEUE an approval bound to sha256(session_id|tool|args), inject nothing. INTENT_TOOL: move/click/scroll/drag→hid.pointer.*, type→hid.type, combo→hid.combo, launch→hid.app.launch.\n- `kernel/src/tiers.rs`: INPUT_A1=[hid.pointer.move/click/scroll/drag]→A1, INPUT_A2=[hid.type,hid.combo,hid.app.launch]→A2, checked AFTER danger-first (so hid.pointer.delete→A3, unknown→A3 fail-closed). gate: A0/A1→Auto, A2→Queued, A3→ExplicitRequired. This HARD-BOUNDS any remote gesture input: max auto is A1 pointer inside a live armed session; type/launch always queue.\n- LATENT SECURITY FINDING (E): the `egresses` 'on-box only' guarantee for gesture is DOCUMENTED but NOT ENFORCED — `run_gesture` never checks `landmarker.egresses` (the check exists only in perception/perceive.py). Design the enforcement (refuse an egressing landmarker in the local loop; but note a REMOTE landmark source is a different, explicitly-authorized thing — reconcile 'no egressing model on-box' with 'authorized remote landmark stream').\n- REMOTE ARM (B, the trust-widening the owner chose): today arm() needs the LOCAL owner key and there is NO remote arm path (deliberate keystone). The owner wants an authorized phone to arm remotely. Design a DEVICE-SIGNED arm: reuse the approval-signature model — a phone device key (in authorized_devices) signs an 'arm' request (via the bridge's device-signed request envelope), the PC verifies it against authorized_devices (owner-minted keys only, RP-APPROVAL-2), and SessionGate gains a `arm_by_device(signed_request)` path that appends a `gesture.session_armed` record whose authorization is the VERIFIED device signature (not the owner key). Preserve: TTL bound, hand-loss/expiry disarm, A1-inject/A2-queue tier bound, single live session, replay-resistance (nonce/timestamp), and an owner-side kill/disarm that always wins. Enumerate the NEW attack surface this opens and how each is closed.\n- RECALL (C): `sigil/perception/recall.py` `recall(store, subject)->{seq,entry_hash,when,frame_sha256,quote}` (A0, grounded, verbatim OCR line) — CLI-only today, no remote endpoint. Design a READ-ONLY bridge endpoint surfacing it (grounded, provenance-carrying). Also note perception Frame ingest is local-only (no inbound-frame contract) — decide whether phone camera→perception is in scope or explicitly deferred (recommend defer; recall over existing grounded records is the cheap win).\n- MOBILE BACKEND (D): `sigil/platform/` has linux(REAL)/macos(SEAM)/windows(SEAM) HostBackends; NO Android/iOS/Termux — `sys.platform=='linux'` on Termux silently gets LinuxBackend. `base.py` HostBackend Protocol: capture_screen/capture_camera/capabilities; CapabilityDescriptor(host_id,os,has_screen,has_camera,has_gpu_vlm,always_on,has_hid_inject,has_camera_stream). Design an Android/Termux backend branch (honest-None where unavailable; detect Termux) so a phone that runs the Python core is described honestly — but note the PRIMARY phone client is the PWA (parallel workstream), so this backend is for a phone that ALSO runs SIGIL python (secondary). Keep it light/honest.\n\nDESIGN THESE SLICES:\n1. Network landmark source + landmarker seam (new `sigil/gesture/remote.py`): a `RemoteLandmarkSource`/`RemoteLandmarker` that yields/returns `List[Hand]` decoded from a device-authenticated landmark stream (over the bridge transport). Define the wire schema (compact Hand JSON), the AUTH (each landmark batch must belong to a live session armed by an authorized device — do landmarks need per-batch signing, or is session-binding enough? argue it), rate/DoS bounds, and exactly where it plugs into run_gesture. Preserve: the WARDEN/session gate stays downstream (bounded to A1/A2); landmarks entering an UNARMED session do nothing.\n2. Device-signed remote arm in SessionGate (B): the new arm_by_device path + record shape + verification + the reconciliation with the owner-key-local arm. FULL threat enumeration (forged arm, replayed arm, arm-after-revoke, arm without a live tunnel, remote-arm then owner-disarm race, a malicious landmark stream in a device-armed session). This slice MUST get a dedicated adversarial review.\n3. Enforce the egresses gate in run_gesture (E) + reconcile with the authorized remote stream (the local landmarker must be non-egressing; the remote stream is a distinct, session+device-authorized source, not an 'egressing model').\n4. Read-only remote recall endpoint (C) on the bridge (grounded/provenance).\n5. Android/Termux HostBackend (D): platform detection + honest capabilities.\n6. Tests (`tests/test_gesture_remote.py` + additions): deterministic doubles (scripted Hand batches, a fake authorized device key, temp SpineStore). NEGATIVE controls: landmarks into an unarmed session inject nothing; a forged/unauthorized device cannot arm; a replayed arm refused; type/launch from a remote gesture ALWAYS queues (never auto); owner disarm beats a device-armed session; the enforced egresses gate refuses an egressing local landmarker.\n\nReuse-first: name exact reuse (SessionGate, GesturePipeline, RuleClassifier, Hand, verify_approval/authorized_devices for the device-signed arm, the bridge device-signed envelope from the parallel workstream, recall(), CapabilityDescriptor/HostBackend, tiers.rs INTENT_TOOL bound). For each slice: files, security invariants preserved, adversarial lenses. Emphasize that (B) remote-arm is the highest-risk slice and gets red-pen + independent adversarial-sweep (the project's standing bar for trust-widening). Give a build order (safe/read-only first — recall; then landmark stream into LOCAL-armed session; then the device-signed remote arm LAST with dual review) and per-slice verification."},"uuid":"e328bd43-d668-406b-bd97-8751ffc336d8","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:11.638Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Arms the session on start (indicator lit), disarms in a\n3\t`finally` (indicator cleared even on crash). Graceful fallbacks; components are injectable so the\n4\twhole loop runs deterministically on scripted doubles with no camera/model/OS input.\"\"\"\n5\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n6\t\n7\tfrom typing import Optional\n8\t\n9\tfrom .pipeline import GesturePipeline\n10\tfrom .session import SessionGate\n11\t\n12\t\n13\tdef run_gesture(*, store=None, owner_key=None, source=None, landmarker=None, classifier=None,\n14\t                backend=None, pipeline=None, gate=None, max_frames: Optional[int] = None) -> int:\n15\t    \"\"\"Run the loop; returns the number of frames processed. Injectable for tests.\"\"\"\n16\t    if store is None:\n17\t        from ..spine.store import SpineStore\n18\t        store = SpineStore()\n19\t    if source is None:\n20\t        from ..perception.camera_stream import CameraStreamSource\n21\t        source = CameraStreamSource()\n22\t    if landmarker is None:\n23\t        from .landmark import OnnxHandLandmarker\n24\t        landmarker = OnnxHandLandmarker()\n25\t    if classifier is None:\n26\t        from .features import RuleClassifier\n27\t        classifier = RuleClassifier()\n28\t    if backend is None:\n29\t        from ..platform import input_backend\n30\t        backend = input_backend()\n31\t    pipe = pipeline or GesturePipeline()\n32\t    g = gate or SessionGate(store, backend, owner_key=owner_key)\n33\t    g.arm(owner_key=owner_key)\n34\t    n = 0\n35\t    try:\n36\t        for frame in source.frames():\n37\t            reading = classifier.classify(landmarker.detect(frame))\n38\t            intent = pipe.on_frame(reading)\n39\t            if intent is not None:\n40\t                g.handle(intent)\n41\t            n += 1\n42\t            if max_frames is not None and n >= max_frames:\n43\t                break\n44\t    finally:\n45\t        g.disarm()\n46\t    return n\n47\t"}]},"uuid":"77bbdd93-c616-4059-9bc9-37b5d043e14e","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:24.107Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9b5bdd14-4ceb-44ee-a657-1d41fe101140","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Every FSM/session/gate test runs against these scripted doubles: no camera, no\n3\tmodel, no OS input. The real providers (`landmark.OnnxHandLandmarker`, `classifier.*`, the platform\n4\t`InputBackend`s) live behind the same Protocols and lazy-import their heavy deps.\"\"\"\n5\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n6\t\n7\tfrom typing import List, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n8\t\n9\tfrom .types import GestureReading, Hand\n10\t\n11\t\n12\t@runtime_checkable\n13\tclass LandmarkModel(Protocol):\n14\t    egresses: bool                                    # on-box models are False; the loop refuses egressing ones\n15\t    def detect(self, image) -> List[Hand]: ...        # 21-keypoint hands, or [] (honest empty)\n16\t\n17\t\n18\t@runtime_checkable\n19\tclass GestureModel(Protocol):\n20\t    def classify(self, hands: List[Hand]) -> GestureReading: ...\n21\t\n22\t\n23\t@runtime_checkable\n24\tclass InputBackend(Protocol):\n25\t    def move(self, dx: float, dy: float) -> None: ...\n26\t    def click(self, button: str = \"left\") -> None: ...\n27\t    def scroll(self, dx: int, dy: int) -> None: ...\n28\t    def type(self, text: str) -> None: ...\n29\t    def combo(self, keys: str) -> None: ...\n30\t\n31\t\n32\t# --- deterministic doubles ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n33\tclass ScriptedLandmarker:\n34\t    \"\"\"Ignores the image; replays a scripted sequence of hand observations.\"\"\"\n35\t    egresses = False\n36\t\n37\t    def __init__(self, sequence: List[List[Hand]]):\n38\t        self._seq = list(sequence)\n39\t        self._i = 0\n40\t\n41\t    def detect(self, image) -> List[Hand]:\n42\t        if self._i >= len(self._seq):\n43\t            return []\n44\t        obs = self._seq[self._i]\n45\t        self._i += 1\n46\t        return obs\n47\t\n48\t\n49\tclass ScriptedGestures:\n50\t    \"\"\"Replays a scripted sequence of GestureReadings (bypasses the model).\"\"\"\n51\t    def __init__(self, readings: List[GestureReading]):\n52\t        self._seq = list(readings)\n53\t        self._i = 0\n54\t\n55\t    def classify(self, hands: List[Hand]) -> GestureReading:\n56\t        if self._i >= len(self._seq):\n57\t            return GestureReading(\"neutral\", 0.0)\n58\t        r = self._seq[self._i]\n59\t        self._i += 1\n60\t        return r\n61\t\n62\t\n63\tclass RecordingInputBackend:\n64\t    \"\"\"Records every injection call; touches NO OS. The double every gate test drives.\"\"\"\n65\t    def __init__(self):\n66\t        self.calls: List[tuple] = []\n67\t\n68\t    def move(self, dx, dy): self.calls.append((\"move\", dx, dy))\n69\t    def click(self, button=\"left\"): self.calls.append((\"click\", button))\n70\t    def scroll(self, dx, dy): self.calls.append((\"scroll\", dx, dy))\n71\t    def type(self, text): self.calls.append((\"type\", text))\n72\t    def combo(self, keys): self.calls.append((\"combo\", keys))\n73\t"}]},"uuid":"32931353-0af6-41d5-a01c-e5583944cc53","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:24.117Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d657493f-4002-442d-b021-eaaec23b9be8","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"05960ed2-d569-4372-af7d-2f355f8bc213","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Xw53D5v5cyMyQBLohJzdb3","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"SessionGate (Phase 8, WS-F, THE KEYSTONE) — the ONLY authority that injects input, and only inside\n2\tan owner-armed session. Two enforcement layers so a gesture can NEVER trigger an unintended action:\n3\t\n4\t  Layer 1 — the SESSION: `arm()` REQUIRES the owner key (it cannot be armed without the owner\n5\t  identity) and appends a signed `gesture.session_armed` record — the tamper-evident AUDIT proof-of-\n6\t  authorization, indicator-lit. The INJECTION gate itself is the live in-memory session, held ONLY by\n7\t  the owner's own running daemon process; it is BOUNDED by a TTL and ended by disarm / hand-loss /\n8\t  expiry. Injection is REFUSED with no live session.\n9\t\n10\t  Layer 2 — per intent, the tier is DERIVED from the WARDEN oracle (`hid.*` names): A1 (pointer\n11\t  move/click/scroll/drag) injects within the session; A2 (type/combo/app.launch) is QUEUED for a\n12\t  verified owner/device approval bound to `sha256(session_id|tool|args)` and NEVER auto-injected — so\n13\t  a gesture alone can never type a password or launch an app.\n14\t\n15\tOnly arm/disarm + DISCRETE actions (click/scroll/drag injected; type/launch queued) hit the spine —\n16\tper-frame pointer MOVES are telemetry (30 FPS records would DoS the append-only log).\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\timport time\n20\timport uuid\n21\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n22\tfrom typing import Optional\n23\t\n24\tfrom ..agents.base import Tier\n25\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n26\tfrom .components import InputBackend\n27\tfrom .types import GestureIntent\n28\t\n29\tSESSION_ARMED = \"gesture.session_armed\"\n30\tSESSION_DISARMED = \"gesture.session_disarmed\"\n31\tACTION_SIGNAL = \"gesture.action\"\n32\t\n33\tINTENT_TOOL = {\n34\t    \"move\": \"hid.pointer.move\", \"click\": \"hid.pointer.click\",\n35\t    \"scroll_left\": \"hid.pointer.scroll\", \"scroll_right\": \"hid.pointer.scroll\",\n36\t    \"drag\": \"hid.pointer.drag\", \"type\": \"hid.type\", \"combo\": \"hid.combo\", \"launch\": \"hid.app.launch\",\n37\t}\n38\t\n39\t\n40\t@dataclass\n41\tclass Session:\n42\t    session_id: str\n43\t    live: bool = True\n44\t    expires_at: float = 0.0            # wallclock deadline — a session is BOUNDED, never indefinite\n45\t\n46\t    def expired(self, now: float) -> bool:\n47\t        return self.expires_at > 0.0 and now >= self.expires_at\n48\t\n49\t\n50\tclass SessionGate:\n51\t    def __init__(self, store, backend: InputBackend, *, classifier=None, owner_key=None):\n52\t        self.store = store\n53\t        self.backend = backend\n54\t        self._classifier = classifier\n55\t        self._owner_key = owner_key\n56\t        self.session: Optional[Session] = None\n57\t\n58\t    def _cls(self):\n59\t        if self._classifier is None:\n60\t            from ..agents.kernel_classify import KernelClassifier\n61\t            self._classifier = KernelClassifier()\n62\t        return self._classifier\n63\t\n64\t    # --- Layer 1: the owner-armed session ---------------------------------------------------------\n65\t    def arm(self, *, owner_key=None, ttl_seconds: float = 1800.0) -> Session:\n66\t        from ..governor.authn import signed_payload\n67\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair\n68\t        ok = owner_key if owner_key is not None else (self._owner_key or owner_keypair())\n69\t        if ok is None:\n70\t            raise RuntimeError(\"cannot arm a gesture session without the owner key (BLOCK-3)\")\n71\t        sid = uuid.uuid4().hex\n72\t        core = {\"signal\": SESSION_ARMED, \"session_id\": sid}\n73\t        self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n74\t                          payload={**signed_payload(core, ok), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\",\n75\t                                   \"ttl_seconds\": ttl_seconds,\n76\t                                   \"summary\": \"gesture session ARMED (indicator lit — opt-in)\"})\n77\t        self.session = Session(sid, live=True, expires_at=time.time() + ttl_seconds)\n78\t        return self.session\n79\t\n80\t    def disarm(self) -> None:\n81\t        if self.session is not None:\n82\t            self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n83\t                              payload={\"signal\": SESSION_DISARMED, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n84\t                                       \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\", \"summary\": \"gesture session DISARMED\"})\n85\t            self.session.live = False\n86\t        self.session = None\n87\t\n88\t    # --- Layer 2: per-intent tier gate ------------------------------------------------------------\n89\t    def handle(self, intent: GestureIntent) -> dict:\n90\t        \"\"\"Authorize + act on ONE intent. Returns a verdict dict. Injection ONLY inside a live session\n91\t        and ONLY for A1 tools; A2+ queues for approval and injects NOTHING; a danger name → refused.\"\"\"\n92\t        if intent.kind == \"hand_lost\":\n93\t            self.disarm()\n94\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"hand lost — session disarmed\"}\n95\t        if self.session is None or not self.session.live:\n96\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"no armed session — injection refused\"}\n97\t        if self.session.expired(time.time()):             # BLOCK-2: a session is bounded, never indefinite\n98\t            self.disarm()\n99\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"session expired — disarmed\"}\n100\t        tool = INTENT_TOOL.get(intent.kind)\n101\t        if tool is None:\n102\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": f\"unknown intent {intent.kind}\"}\n103\t        tier = self._cls().classify(tool)                 # DERIVED, fail-closed A3 on any error\n104\t        args = f\"{intent.dx:.4f},{intent.dy:.4f},{intent.arg}\"\n105\t        if tier <= Tier.A1:\n106\t            self._inject(intent)\n107\t            # BLOCK-1: log the DISCRETE A1 injections that actually take effect (click/scroll/drag);\n108\t            # per-frame `move` is telemetry (logging it at 30 FPS would DoS the append-only spine).\n109\t            if intent.kind != \"move\":\n110\t                self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n111\t                                  payload={\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"auto\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n112\t                                           \"tool\": tool, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n113\t                                           \"summary\": f\"gesture {tool} injected\"})\n114\t            return {\"injected\": True, \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool}\n115\t        # A2/A3 → QUEUE an approval bound to this exact action; inject NOTHING\n116\t        token = sha256_hex(f\"{self.session.session_id}|{tool}|{args}\".encode(\"utf-8\"))\n117\t        seq = self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"PERCEPTION\",\n118\t                                payload={\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"queued\",\n119\t                                         \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n120\t                                         \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token, \"args\": args,\n121\t                                         \"subject\": f\"gesture action {tool} (awaiting approval)\"})\n122\t        return {\"injected\": False, \"queued\": seq, \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token}\n123\t\n124\t    def _inject(self, intent: GestureIntent) -> None:\n125\t        b = self.backend\n126\t        if intent.kind == \"move\" or intent.kind == \"drag\":\n127\t            b.move(intent.dx, intent.dy)\n128\t        elif intent.kind == \"click\":\n129\t            b.click()\n130\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_left\":\n131\t            b.scroll(-1, 0)\n132\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_right\":\n133\t            b.scroll(1, 0)\n134\t"}]},"uuid":"4bbf2dc1-b5ec-43db-9136-a160c10f809b","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:24.120Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"05960ed2-d569-4372-af7d-2f355f8bc213","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

A `Hand` is a 21-keypoint landmark set; a `GestureReading`\n2\tis the classifier's per-frame verdict (label + confidence + top1−top2 margin + pointer kinematics); a\n3\t`GestureIntent` is what the FSM decides to DO (still not an injection — the SessionGate authorizes).\"\"\"\n4\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n5\t\n6\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n7\tfrom typing import List, Tuple\n8\t\n9\t\n10\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n11\tclass Hand:\n12\t    landmarks: Tuple[Tuple[float, float, float], ...]   # 21 (x,y,z), normalized to the frame\n13\t    handedness: str = \"Right\"\n14\t    score: float = 1.0\n15\t\n16\t\n17\t# A HandObservation is a list[Hand] (empty = no hand in frame).\n18\t\n19\t\n20\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n21\tclass GestureReading:\n22\t    label: str                 # \"point\"|\"pinch\"|\"fist\"|\"open\"|\"neutral\"|\"swipe_left\"|\"swipe_right\"|\"spread\"|...\n23\t    confidence: float = 0.0\n24\t    dx: float = 0.0            # pointer kinematics (normalized) for the \"point\" driver\n25\t    dy: float = 0.0\n26\t    margin: float = 1.0        # top1 − top2 confidence margin (small ⇒ ambiguous ⇒ do nothing)\n27\t\n28\t\n29\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n30\tclass GestureIntent:\n31\t    kind: str                  # \"move\"|\"click\"|\"scroll_left\"|\"scroll_right\"|\"drag\"|\"type\"|\"launch\"|\"hand_lost\"|\"none\"\n32\t    dx: float = 0.0\n33\t    dy: float = 0.0\n34\t    arg: str = \"\"              # e.g. text to type / app to launch (owner-approved before it ever fires)\n35\t\n36\t\n37\tdef empty_observation() -> List[Hand]:\n38\t    return []\n39\t"}]},"uuid":"2e64f317-9107-4c8c-99ad-cdd1ea1e54d8","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:30.120Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"f42f9fc9-7374-4a9b-99c0-4840e90a2e95","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"6ea4c79f-4b0c-4485-8872-b995fc2b7a24","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BjB5bsxBZohNea1QUrBrMV","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"GesturePipeline (Phase 8, WS-F) — a frame-driven, debounced intent FSM, a structural copy of\n2\t`voice/pipeline.py`: timing in FRAME COUNTS (not wallclock), hysteresis so one noisy frame fires\n3\tNOTHING. `on_frame(reading) -> Optional[GestureIntent]`. Fail-safe by construction:\n4\t\n5\t  • a POINT pose drives continuous pointer `move` intents (deadzone-filtered);\n6\t  • a discrete gesture (pinch→click, swipe→scroll, spread→launch, twofinger→type) fires ONLY after\n7\t    `confirm_frames` consecutive identical HIGH-confidence, HIGH-margin readings, then a cooldown;\n8\t  • low confidence OR a small top1−top2 margin ⇒ NEUTRAL ⇒ counter resets ⇒ nothing fires (ambiguity\n9\t    does nothing);\n10\t  • `hand_lost_frames` of no-hand/neutral ⇒ a `hand_lost` intent so the session AUTO-DISARMS.\n11\t\n12\tThe FSM decides INTENT; authorization (a live armed session + the WARDEN tier) is the SessionGate's\n13\tjob — so this stays a pure, deterministically-testable state machine.\"\"\"\n14\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n15\t\n16\tfrom typing import Optional\n17\t\n18\tfrom .types import GestureIntent, GestureReading\n19\t\n20\t# discrete gesture label → intent kind (a POINT pose is the continuous move driver, handled separately)\n21\tDISCRETE = {\n22\t    \"pinch\": \"click\", \"swipe_left\": \"scroll_left\", \"swipe_right\": \"scroll_right\",\n23\t    \"spread\": \"launch\", \"twofinger\": \"type\", \"grab\": \"drag\",\n24\t}\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tclass GesturePipeline:\n28\t    def __init__(self, *, confirm_frames: int = 4, cooldown_frames: int = 6, hand_lost_frames: int = 8,\n29\t                 conf_min: float = 0.6, margin_min: float = 0.15, deadzone: float = 0.002):\n30\t        self.confirm_frames = confirm_frames\n31\t        self.cooldown_frames = cooldown_frames\n32\t        self.hand_lost_frames = hand_lost_frames\n33\t        self.conf_min = conf_min\n34\t        self.margin_min = margin_min\n35\t        self.deadzone = deadzone\n36\t        self._label: Optional[str] = None\n37\t        self._count = 0\n38\t        self._cool = 0\n39\t        self._lost = 0\n40\t\n41\t    def on_frame(self, reading: Optional[GestureReading]) -> Optional[GestureIntent]:\n42\t        if self._cool > 0:\n43\t            self._cool -= 1\n44\t        # no hand / explicit neutral → count toward auto-disarm; a discrete streak is broken\n45\t        if reading is None or not reading.label or reading.label == \"neutral\":\n46\t            self._label, self._count = None, 0\n47\t            self._lost += 1\n48\t            if self._lost >= self.hand_lost_frames:\n49\t                self._lost = 0\n50\t                return GestureIntent(\"hand_lost\")\n51\t            return None\n52\t        self._lost = 0\n53\t        # AMBIGUITY → nothing (fail-safe): a single noisy or low-margin frame cannot fire\n54\t        if reading.confidence < self.conf_min or reading.margin < self.margin_min:\n55\t            self._label, self._count = None, 0\n56\t            return None\n57\t        if reading.label == \"point\":                       # continuous pointer control\n58\t            self._label, self._count = None, 0\n59\t            if abs(reading.dx) < self.deadzone and abs(reading.dy) < self.deadzone:\n60\t                return None\n61\t            return GestureIntent(\"move\", dx=reading.dx, dy=reading.dy)\n62\t        # a discrete gesture: require `confirm_frames` consecutive identical readings (hysteresis)\n63\t        if reading.label == self._label:\n64\t            self._count += 1\n65\t        else:\n66\t            self._label, self._count = reading.label, 1\n67\t        if self._count >= self.confirm_frames and self._cool == 0:\n68\t            self._count = 0\n69\t            self._cool = self.cooldown_frames\n70\t            kind = DISCRETE.get(reading.label, \"none\")\n71\t            return GestureIntent(kind, arg=reading.label) if kind != \"none\" else None\n72\t        return None\n73\t"}]},"uuid":"158e6682-fcd8-44d2-b258-187940b75849","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:30.903Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6ea4c79f-4b0c-4485-8872-b995fc2b7a24","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

The `ScriptedLandmarker` double (in `components.py`) drives every test.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom pathlib import Path\n10\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n11\t\n12\tfrom ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n13\tfrom .types import Hand\n14\t\n15\t_MODEL = SIGIL_HOME / \"models\" / \"hand_landmark.onnx\"\n16\t\n17\t\n18\tclass OnnxHandLandmarker:\n19\t    egresses = False\n20\t\n21\t    def __init__(self, model_path: Optional[str] = None):\n22\t        self.model_path = Path(model_path) if model_path else _MODEL\n23\t        self._session = None\n24\t\n25\t    def _sess(self):\n26\t        if self._session is None:\n27\t            try:\n28\t                import onnxruntime as ort\n29\t                if not self.model_path.exists():\n30\t                    return None\n31\t                self._session = ort.InferenceSession(str(self.model_path),\n32\t                                                     providers=ort.get_available_providers())\n33\t            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — no runtime/model → honest empty\n34\t                return None\n35\t        return self._session\n36\t\n37\t    def detect(self, image) -> List[Hand]:\n38\t        sess = self._sess()\n39\t        if sess is None or image is None:\n40\t            return []\n41\t        try:\n42\t            import numpy as np\n43\t            # NOTE: a wired model preprocesses (resize/normalize) + parses the palm-ROI → 21-kp output.\n44\t            # Kept deliberately minimal here: with no bundled .onnx this path returns [] (honest gap),\n45\t            # exactly like capture.grab_camera returning None rather than a fabricated frame.\n46\t            _ = np  # preprocessing lives here in a bundled build\n47\t            return []\n48\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n49\t            return []\n50\t"}]},"uuid":"14527984-2fe6-4b67-a8e8-0afc8d7ba885","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:31.165Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"832d3f03-fe77-4db9-bde4-d731ab73a14b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"9bc5a3f5-c49d-4722-a38f-fd5c9006feb2","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FruzN8GBPZ3LYcZTZk6kAM","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Perception recall (Phase 7, WS-A V-iv) — \"where did I last see X?\" answered from GROUNDED\n2\tperception history. Scans perception `event` records for the most recent whose authoritative OCR\n3\t`captured_text` contains the subject (all its salient tokens), and serves the VERBATIM OCR span +\n4\tframe ref + timestamp — the owner's own on-screen text, never a paraphrase and never an advisory VLM\n5\tlead. A0 (observe). Reuses the `consolidate.gate` grounding tokenizer + verbatim-span extractor so\n6\trecall grounds exactly like the memory gate.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom typing import Optional\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..consolidate.gate import salient\n12\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n13\t\n14\tPERCEPTION_SIGNAL = \"perception\"\n15\t\n16\t\n17\tdef _grounded_line(subject_tokens: set[str], captured: str) -> Optional[str]:\n18\t    \"\"\"The verbatim OCR LINE that contains ALL the subject's salient tokens (so the served sighting\n19\t    always actually shows the subject), or None if no single line holds them (red-pen BLOCK-4 — a\n20\t    whole-frame token match whose tokens are scattered across lines is NOT a grounded sighting).\"\"\"\n21\t    for line in captured.splitlines():\n22\t        if line.strip() and subject_tokens <= salient(line):\n23\t            return line.strip()\n24\t    return None\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tdef recall(store: SpineStore, subject: str) -> Optional[dict]:\n28\t    \"\"\"The most recent grounded sighting of `subject`, or None. Grounded = every salient token of the\n29\t    subject appears in that frame's captured OCR text (the authoritative ground truth).\"\"\"\n30\t    subj = salient(subject)\n31\t    if not subj:\n32\t        return None\n33\t    latest = None\n34\t    latest_line = None\n35\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n36\t        if r.kind != \"event\" or r.payload.get(\"signal\") != PERCEPTION_SIGNAL:\n37\t            continue\n38\t        line = _grounded_line(subj, r.payload.get(\"captured_text\") or \"\")\n39\t        if line is not None:                  # subject co-located on a real OCR line → a grounded sighting\n40\t            latest, latest_line = r, line     # seq-ascending iteration → last match is most recent\n41\t    if latest is None:\n42\t        return None\n43\t    return {\n44\t        \"seq\": latest.seq, \"entry_hash\": latest.entry_hash, \"when\": latest.ts,\n45\t        \"frame_sha256\": latest.payload.get(\"frame_sha256\"),\n46\t        \"quote\": latest_line,                 # verbatim OCR line that actually contains the subject\n47\t    }\n48\t"}]},"uuid":"6cfa76e5-561a-41d8-825a-f934966062d8","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:31.486Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9bc5a3f5-c49d-4722-a38f-fd5c9006feb2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"55927403-c19e-4806-b4d8-efb6e1b58a7b","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01FDAx2EjZhP5kiYYE1tA1MP","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The host-backend contract (Phase 7, WS-D). A `HostBackend` captures screen/camera into the same\n2\t`Frame` the perception stack already consumes, and advertises what the host can do. The capability\n3\tdescriptor is what the mesh routes on (see `sigil.mesh`): which host has a camera, a GPU for a local\n4\tVLM, and is always-on — so vision/compute go to the best-capable ONLINE host while authority stays\n5\tin the one signed spine.\"\"\"\n6\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n7\t\n8\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n9\tfrom typing import Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..perception.capture import Frame\n12\t\n13\t\n14\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n15\tclass CapabilityDescriptor:\n16\t    host_id: str\n17\t    os: str\n18\t    has_screen: bool\n19\t    has_camera: bool\n20\t    has_gpu_vlm: bool          # a local moondream-class VLM is reachable (Ollama up)\n21\t    always_on: bool\n22\t    has_hid_inject: bool = False    # this host can inject cursor/keyboard events (WS-F gesture control)\n23\t    has_camera_stream: bool = False # this host can stream the camera (persistent, low-latency)\n24\t\n25\t    def to_dict(self) -> dict:\n26\t        return {\"host_id\": self.host_id, \"os\": self.os, \"has_screen\": self.has_screen,\n27\t                \"has_camera\": self.has_camera, \"has_gpu_vlm\": self.has_gpu_vlm, \"always_on\": self.always_on,\n28\t                \"has_hid_inject\": self.has_hid_inject, \"has_camera_stream\": self.has_camera_stream}\n29\t\n30\t\n31\t@runtime_checkable\n32\tclass HostBackend(Protocol):\n33\t    def capture_screen(self) -> Optional[Frame]: ...\n34\t    def capture_camera(self) -> Optional[Frame]: ...\n35\t    def capabilities(self) -> CapabilityDescriptor: ...\n36\t\n37\t\n38\t# --- shared, OS-agnostic probes ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n39\tdef host_id() -> str:\n40\t    \"\"\"A stable per-host id (persisted once under SIGIL_HOME). Identifies this host in the mesh.\"\"\"\n41\t    import uuid\n42\t\n43\t    from ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n44\t    f = SIGIL_HOME / \"host_id\"\n45\t    try:\n46\t        v = f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip()\n47\t        if v:\n48\t            return v\n49\t    except OSError:\n50\t        pass\n51\t    SIGIL_HOME.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n52\t    hid = uuid.uuid4().hex[:16]\n53\t    try:\n54\t        f.write_text(hid, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n55\t    except OSError:\n56\t        pass\n57\t    return hid\n58\t\n59\t\n60\tdef probe_gpu_vlm() -> bool:\n61\t    \"\"\"True iff a local moondream-class VLM endpoint (Ollama) is reachable — cheap TCP probe.\"\"\"\n62\t    import os\n63\t    import socket\n64\t    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n65\t    u = urlparse(os.environ.get(\"OLLAMA_HOST\", \"http://127.0.0.1:11434\"))\n66\t    try:\n67\t        with socket.create_connection((u.hostname or \"127.0.0.1\", u.port or 11434), timeout=0.5):\n68\t            return True\n69\t    except OSError:\n70\t        return False\n71\t\n72\t\n73\tdef probe_always_on() -> bool:\n74\t    import os\n75\t    return os.environ.get(\"SIGIL_ALWAYS_ON\", \"\").lower() in (\"1\", \"true\", \"yes\")\n76\t"}]},"uuid":"e7f437cb-5804-4f76-a54e-a6c19b3f1cf7","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:41.303Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"55927403-c19e-4806-b4d8-efb6e1b58a7b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"69d55c32-700b-4866-8e49-cf9263d69144","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Cokj6p299YruSXKhUNgz6j","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Shared authentication for governance events (Phase 6). Every state-changing governance event\n2\t(promotion grant/revoke, kill engage/release, approval approve/deny) carries an Ed25519 signature by\n3\tthe OWNER key over its canonical authenticated CORE fields, plus the signer's pubkey. Verification is\n4\tfail-closed: no trusted key, no signature, a pubkey that isn't the trusted owner key, or a tampered\n5\tcore → NOT authentic. This is the primitive that makes \"zero unauthorized A2/A3\" provable from the\n6\tlog rather than promised (a forged governance event never verifies, so it is ignored).\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom typing import Optional, Sequence\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sign, verify_one\n12\t\n13\t\n14\tdef _canon(core: dict) -> bytes:\n15\t    m = canonical_json(core)\n16\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n17\t\n18\t\n19\tdef signed_payload(core: dict, owner_key) -> dict:\n20\t    \"\"\"core = the authenticated fields (must be JSON-canonicalizable). Returns core + {sig, pubkey}.\n21\t    With no owner key, sig/pubkey are None → the event will never verify (a caller that requires\n22\t    authentication must reject it).\"\"\"\n23\t    sig = sign(owner_key.private_key_b64, _canon(core)) if owner_key else None\n24\t    return {**core, \"sig\": sig, \"pubkey\": owner_key.public_key_b64 if owner_key else None}\n25\t\n26\t\n27\tdef verify_signed(payload: dict, core_fields: Sequence[str], trusted_pubkey: Optional[str]) -> bool:\n28\t    \"\"\"True iff `payload` carries a valid owner signature over its declared core fields. Fail-closed.\"\"\"\n29\t    if not trusted_pubkey:\n30\t        return False\n31\t    sig = payload.get(\"sig\")\n32\t    if not sig or payload.get(\"pubkey\") != trusted_pubkey:\n33\t        return False\n34\t    core = {k: payload.get(k) for k in core_fields}\n35\t    return verify_one(trusted_pubkey, _canon(core), sig)\n36\t"}]},"uuid":"6030a4f3-cc22-4f65-b691-fb40ab1a1af0","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:08:53.554Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"69d55c32-700b-4866-8e49-cf9263d69144","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"3b3b7737-c61c-4ebc-8660-f6e8f50620e4","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013RGY4aca8uE2WSKCcXn1Zc","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"BridgeDaemon (Phase 7, WS-D D-v) — the desktop-side API the phone talks to over WireGuard. It\n2\treuses the owner-signed cores: the queue (`approvals.pending` with the authorized-device set), a\n3\tDEVICE-signed approval (accepted only while that device is authorized), a PANIC halt (any engage is\n4\tfail-safe), and a KERNEL command relay (`KernelDispatch` → the same WARDEN gate as voice/UI).\n5\t\n6\tThis module is the bridge LIBRARY CORE + API (the doctrine + crypto). The network TRANSPORT — an\n7\tHTTP server over WireGuard, reusing the WS-C two-plane server pattern bound to a `bind_ok` address —\n8\tis a documented NEXT slice, not shipped here. `bind_ok` is the bind predicate that transport MUST\n9\tuse: loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) address only — NEVER 0.0.0.0 / a public address.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport ipaddress\n13\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n14\t\n15\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n16\t\n17\t\n18\tdef bind_ok(addr: str) -> bool:\n19\t    \"\"\"True iff `addr` is safe to bind: loopback or a PRIVATE (e.g. WireGuard) address — never\n20\t    0.0.0.0 / a public / an unspecified address.\"\"\"\n21\t    try:\n22\t        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(addr)\n23\t    except ValueError:\n24\t        return False\n25\t    if ip.is_unspecified:                          # 0.0.0.0 / :: → refuse\n26\t        return False\n27\t    return ip.is_loopback or ip.is_private\n28\t\n29\t\n30\tclass BridgeDaemon:\n31\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, trusted_pubkey: Optional[str] = None):\n32\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n33\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n34\t        # the owner trust anchor — the persisted identity by default (injectable for tests)\n35\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n36\t\n37\t    def _authorized(self):\n38\t        from ..mesh import authorized_devices\n39\t        return authorized_devices(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey)\n40\t\n41\t    def pending(self) -> List[dict]:\n42\t        \"\"\"The phone-facing queue — minimal fields only (no subject leaks over the tunnel).\"\"\"\n43\t        from ..agents.approvals import pending\n44\t        items = pending(self.store, self.trusted_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=self._authorized())\n45\t        return [{\"seq\": r.seq, \"tier\": r.payload.get(\"tier\"), \"kind\": r.kind} for r in items]\n46\t\n47\t    def submit_device_approval(self, payload: dict) -> int:\n48\t        \"\"\"Append a DEVICE-signed approval the phone produced — ONLY if the signing device is\n49\t        currently authorized AND the signature verifies (fail-closed). A rogue/revoked device or a\n50\t        forged signature is refused; the signed target_seq binds (no replay).\"\"\"\n51\t        from ..agents.approvals import SIGNAL as APPROVAL_SIGNAL\n52\t        from ..agents.approvals import verify_approval\n53\t\n54\t        class _Rec:\n55\t            def __init__(self, p): self.payload = p\n56\t        authorized = self._authorized()\n57\t        if payload.get(\"signal\") != APPROVAL_SIGNAL:\n58\t            raise ValueError(\"not an approval record\")\n59\t        if payload.get(\"pubkey\") not in authorized:\n60\t            raise ValueError(\"signing device is not authorized\")\n61\t        if not verify_approval(_Rec(payload), self.trusted_pubkey, extra_pubkeys=authorized):\n62\t            raise ValueError(\"approval signature invalid\")\n63\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n64\t                                 payload={**payload, \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"},\n65\t                                 supersedes_id=payload.get(\"target_seq\"))\n66\t\n67\t    def panic_engage(self, *, by: str = \"phone\") -> int:\n68\t        \"\"\"Halt the mesh from the phone. ANY engage halts (fail-safe) — no signature needed for the\n69\t        SAFE direction. Release stays owner-only at the desktop (the dangerous direction is signed).\"\"\"\n70\t        from ..governor.killswitch import SIGNAL as KS_SIGNAL\n71\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n72\t                                 payload={\"signal\": KS_SIGNAL, \"state\": \"engaged\", \"by\": by,\n73\t                                          \"reason\": \"panic halt from phone\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n74\t\n75\t    def relay(self, text: str) -> str:\n76\t        \"\"\"Relay a KERNEL command — the same T0-router + WARDEN gate + signed action log as voice/UI.\"\"\"\n77\t        from ..voice.dispatch import KernelDispatch\n78\t        return KernelDispatch().send(text)\n79\t"}]},"uuid":"2540bc41-0188-4480-bc17-4e21e9b24661","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:09:05.543Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3b3b7737-c61c-4ebc-8660-f6e8f50620e4","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"8b2e0716-7197-4dca-b5c6-319d4d2c1752","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01LUTskzkwbzj5mGge2Mwwe2","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Approval queue (SIGIL §5, §9.3 mobile bridge) — the human gate for A2/A3 proposals. An agent\n2\tQUEUES a proposal (governor → QUEUE); the owner APPROVES or DENIES it here. Authentication is an\n3\tEd25519 signature over the canonical (target, decision, approver) by the OWNER key.\n4\t\n5\tRED-PEN HARDENING (Phase 6):\n6\t • The trusted pubkey is the PERSISTED owner identity — NOT the key supplied to the queue, so an\n7\t   attacker cannot self-certify by bringing their own key (RP-APPROVAL-2). approve/deny require the\n8\t   supplied signing key to BE the trusted owner key.\n9\t • `pending()` treats a queued item as resolved ONLY when a superseding approval VERIFIES against the\n10\t   trusted owner key, and keys resolution off the SIGNED target_seq (not the raw supersedes_id) — so\n11\t   an unsigned/forged approval can't silently drop an item (RP-1/RP-APPROVAL-1), and a genuine\n12\t   approval of one item can't be replayed onto another (RP-APPROVAL-4). `verify_approval` is thereby\n13\t   on the enforcement path (RP-APPROVAL-3).\n14\t\n15\tThis records the DECISION; it executes no external effect (SIGIL has no send/deploy path). The\n16\ttransport (Telegram/WhatsApp over WireGuard, §9.3) is a seam over this authenticated core.\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n20\t\n21\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sha256_hex, sign, verify_one\n22\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n23\t\n24\tSIGNAL = \"governor.approval\"\n25\t_QUEUED_STATUS = \"awaiting-approval\"\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tdef _approval_message(target_seq, decision: str, approver: str) -> bytes:\n29\t    m = canonical_json({\"target\": target_seq, \"decision\": decision, \"approver\": approver})\n30\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n31\t\n32\t\n33\tdef verify_approval(record, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str], *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> bool:\n34\t    \"\"\"True iff the approval carries a valid signature over its (target, decision, approver) by the\n35\t    OWNER key OR by a currently-authorized DEVICE key (`extra_pubkeys`). The claimed `pubkey` must be\n36\t    in the allowed set — which is composed ONLY of owner-minted keys (the owner identity + the\n37\t    owner-signed device-authorization ledger, see `sigil.mesh`) — so a key the requester merely\n38\t    presents is never trusted (RP-APPROVAL-2). The signed `target_seq` still binds (RP-APPROVAL-4).\n39\t    Unsigned / not-in-allowed-set / no-trusted-key → False (fail-closed).\"\"\"\n40\t    p = record.payload if hasattr(record, \"payload\") else record\n41\t    sig, pub = p.get(\"sig\"), p.get(\"pubkey\")\n42\t    allowed = set()\n43\t    if trusted_pubkey_b64:\n44\t        allowed.add(trusted_pubkey_b64)\n45\t    if extra_pubkeys:\n46\t        allowed.update(extra_pubkeys)\n47\t    if not sig or not pub or pub not in allowed:\n48\t        return False\n49\t    msg = _approval_message(p.get(\"target_seq\"), p.get(\"approval\"), p.get(\"approver\"))\n50\t    return verify_one(pub, msg, sig)                # verify against the (owner-minted) claimed key\n51\t\n52\t\n53\tdef pending(store: SpineStore, trusted_pubkey_b64: Optional[str] = None, *, extra_pubkeys=None) -> List:\n54\t    \"\"\"Queued proposals with NO valid approval yet, oldest first. Additive; returns None when the native tool is absent.\"\"\"\n3\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n4\t\n5\timport shutil\n6\timport subprocess\n7\timport tempfile\n8\tfrom pathlib import Path\n9\tfrom typing import Optional\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..perception.capture import Frame, _ocr\n12\tfrom .base import CapabilityDescriptor, host_id, probe_always_on, probe_gpu_vlm\n13\t\n14\t\n15\tclass MacOSBackend:\n16\t    def capture_screen(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n17\t        if not shutil.which(\"screencapture\"):\n18\t            return None\n19\t        out = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=\".png\", prefix=\"sigil-screen-\")\n20\t        try:\n21\t            subprocess.run([\"screencapture\", \"-x\", out], capture_output=True, timeout=20)\n22\t        except (subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError):\n23\t            return None\n24\t        if Path(out).exists() and Path(out).stat().st_size > 0:\n25\t            return Frame.from_image(\"screen\", out, text=_ocr(out))\n26\t        return None\n27\t\n28\t    def capture_camera(self) -> Optional[Frame]:\n29\t        return None                                   # honest gap (optional imagesnap add)\n30\t\n31\t    def capabilities(self) -> CapabilityDescriptor:\n32\t        return CapabilityDescriptor(\n33\t            host_id=host_id(), os=\"macos\", has_screen=bool(shutil.which(\"screencapture\")),\n34\t            has_camera=False, has_gpu_vlm=probe_gpu_vlm(), always_on=probe_always_on())\n35\t"}]},"uuid":"d7eba9db-229f-44a5-a968-03b99dcb5265","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:09:31.518Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a1aa7cd7-f596-4093-8c5b-4a45a947183b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"9ef7ee25-53ab-4098-a026-aa691e768c7a","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"9d13eed4-cf8d-4421-9c14-b807eb2edcdb","agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RZqJZ1Vi4vA61ZL1NHXBCi","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Persistent low-latency camera stream (Phase 8, WS-F F2) — a `voice.backends.MicAudioSource`-style\n2\tgenerator over ONE warm `ffmpeg` rawvideo pipe. Unlike `capture.grab_camera` (which cold-starts an\n3\tffmpeg process + writes a PNG + OCRs PER FRAME — hundreds of ms, unusable for control), this keeps the\n4\tdevice handle open and reads raw RGB frames off stdout. Drop-to-latest so inference never queues\n5\tbehind a slow frame. Honest-empty (no frames) if ffmpeg/device/numpy absent — never a fabricated\n6\tframe. `grab_camera` is left untouched (backward-compatible single-shot).\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\timport shutil\n10\timport subprocess\n11\tfrom pathlib import Path\n12\tfrom typing import Iterator, List, Optional\n13\t\n14\t\n15\tclass CameraStreamSource:\n16\t    def __init__(self, device: str = \"/dev/video0\", width: int = 640, height: int = 480, fps: int = 30):\n17\t        self.device, self.width, self.height, self.fps = device, width, height, fps\n18\t\n19\t    def available(self) -> bool:\n20\t        return bool(shutil.which(\"ffmpeg\")) and Path(self.device).exists()\n21\t\n22\t    def frames(self) -> Iterator:\n23\t        \"\"\"Yield raw RGB frames (numpy HxWx3 uint8) from a single warm ffmpeg process. Ends silently\n24\t        if unavailable.\"\"\"\n25\t        if not self.available():\n26\t            return\n27\t        try:\n28\t            import numpy as np\n29\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — no numpy → no stream (honest)\n30\t            return\n31\t        frame_bytes = self.width * self.height * 3\n32\t        proc: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None\n33\t        try:\n34\t            proc = subprocess.Popen(\n35\t                [\"ffmpeg\", \"-loglevel\", \"quiet\", \"-f\", \"v4l2\", \"-i\", self.device,\n36\t                 \"-f\", \"rawvideo\", \"-pix_fmt\", \"rgb24\", \"-s\", f\"{self.width}x{self.height}\",\n37\t                 \"-r\", str(self.fps), \"pipe:1\"],\n38\t                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)\n39\t            while True:\n40\t                buf = proc.stdout.read(frame_bytes)\n41\t                if not buf or len(buf) < frame_bytes:\n42\t                    break\n43\t                yield np.frombuffer(buf, dtype=np.uint8).reshape((self.height, self.width, 3))\n44\t        except (OSError, ValueError):\n45\t            return\n46\t        finally:\n47\t            if proc is not None:\n48\t                proc.terminate()\n49\t                try:\n50\t                    proc.wait(timeout=2)\n51\t                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n52\t                    proc.kill()\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tclass ScriptedFrameSource:\n56\t    \"\"\"Deterministic double — yields a fixed list of frames (ndarrays or any placeholder). No device.\"\"\"\n57\t    def __init__(self, frames: List):\n58\t        self._frames = list(frames)\n59\t\n60\t    def available(self) -> bool:\n61\t        return True\n62\t\n63\t    def frames(self) -> Iterator:\n64\t        yield from self._frames\n65\t"}]},"uuid":"b2356c37-5bed-4505-9ca5-176fe4d7b25e","timestamp":"2026-07-18T23:09:32.624Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9ef7ee25-53ab-4098-a026-aa691e768c7a","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"a653eb65-3ab9-4c29-8729-99d7912fb29a","isSidechain":true,"agentId":"ab411d9dd9be93e1b","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdANUgzyEVEbUtbCLusWb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I have full ground truth. Here is the design.\n\n---\n\n# SIGIL Phone-Companion Extensions — Slice-by-Slice Implementation Plan\n\n## Verified architecture recap (reuse anchors)\n\nThe gesture stack is a clean pipeline of injectable seams, and the mobile bridge already ships the exact device-signed-authorization machinery this plan needs. The trust-widening (B) is not new crypto — it is a second application of the `verify_approval` / `authorized_devices` model that `BridgeDaemon.submit_device_approval` already uses. That is the single most important reuse insight: **we widen only Layer-1 arm authorization, via an owner-minted device key, and every downstream bound (Layer-2 tier gate, FSM, single live session, TTL, hand-loss disarm) stays byte-for-byte unchanged.**\n\nConcrete reuse points confirmed by exploration:\n\n- `SessionGate` keystone — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/session.py` (`arm`, `disarm`, `handle`, `INTENT_TOOL`, `Session` TTL/expiry).\n- `GesturePipeline` FSM — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/pipeline.py` (unchanged).\n- `RuleClassifier` — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/features.py` (unchanged).\n- `Hand` frozen dataclass — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/types.py` (21×(x,y,z), handedness, score — tiny/serializable, the wire type).\n- `LandmarkModel` Protocol + `ScriptedLandmarker` double — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/components.py` (the `egresses` flag lives here; the RemoteLandmarker implements this Protocol).\n- `run_gesture` loop — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/run.py` (lines 22-24 landmarker default; 33 auto-arm; 36-37 loop body).\n- Device-signed authorization — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/agents/approvals.py` (`verify_approval`, RP-APPROVAL-2/4) + `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/mesh/registry.py` (`authorized_devices`, `authorize_device`, `revoke_device`, `DeviceApprover`, `_DEV_CORE`).\n- Signed-core primitive — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/governor/authn.py` (`signed_payload`, `verify_signed`).\n- Bridge + the exact device-signed-submit template — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/bridge/daemon.py` (`BridgeDaemon.submit_device_approval`, `bind_ok`, `panic_engage`, `relay`, `pending`).\n- Owner-kill-always-wins — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/governor/killswitch.py` (`is_engaged`, \"any engage halts; only an owner-signed release un-halts\").\n- Grounded recall — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/perception/recall.py` (`recall`, provenance dict).\n- Egress-refusal reference pattern — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/perception/perceive.py` lines 104-108, 156-163 (the loop refusal to copy into `run_gesture`).\n- Host backends SEAM pattern — `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/platform/{base,macos,windows}.py` + selection in `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/platform/__init__.py` (`host()`).\n- Kernel tier bound (do NOT touch, cite as the hard ceiling) — `kernel/src/tiers.rs` `INPUT_A1` / `INPUT_A2`, danger-first, unknown→A3 fail-closed.\n\n---\n\n## Slice 1 — Network landmark source + landmarker seam\n\n**New file:** `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/remote.py`\n\n### Wire schema (compact Hand batch)\n`Hand` is already tiny and serializable, so the batch is a thin envelope over it:\n\n```\n{ \"t\": \"hand_batch\",\n  \"session_id\": \"<hex of the live armed session>\",\n  \"seq\": <monotonic int, per-session>,\n  \"ts\": <float, sender wallclock>,\n  \"hands\": [ { \"l\": [[x,y,z] × 21], \"h\": \"R\"|\"L\", \"s\": <score> }, ... 0..2 ] }\n```\n\nDecode into `List[Hand]` (reuse `types.Hand` verbatim). The batch is carried inside the bridge's device-signed request envelope from the parallel workstream — the RemoteLandmarkSource never opens its own socket; it reads decoded batches off a queue the bridge transport feeds.\n\n### AUTH — does each batch need per-batch signing? Argued: **No.**\nSession-binding + monotonic `seq` + a staleness window over the WG-authenticated tunnel is sufficient. Three-step argument:\n\n1. **The channel is already mutually authenticated.** Batches arrive only through the WireGuard-bound bridge (`bind_ok`: loopback/private only, never `0.0.0.0`) inside the device-signed request envelope that established the session. An off-tunnel attacker cannot inject a batch at all.\n2. **The damage is hard-bounded downstream regardless of any per-frame signature.** Landmarks feed `RuleClassifier → GesturePipeline → SessionGate.handle`. The worst a batch can cause is an **A1 pointer op inside an already-live armed session** (move/click/scroll/drag); `type`/`combo`/`launch` always queue for a separate approval (Layer-2, `kernel/src/tiers.rs`). With no live session, a batch injects **nothing** (`session.py` line 95-96). So a forged batch is at most pointer nuisance, never escalation.\n3. **The security-relevant authentication is therefore at the arm boundary (Slice 2) and the channel boundary — not per frame.** Adding 30 Ed25519 verifies/sec buys non-repudiation of each frame and defense against an in-tunnel injector, but an in-tunnel injector is still bounded to A1 nuisance that owner-disarm kills instantly. Not worth the cost.\n\nRecommended cheap hardening (not asymmetric per-frame): reject a batch whose `session_id` ≠ the live session, whose `seq` is ≤ the last accepted seq (drop reorder/duplicate/replay), or whose `ts` is outside a small freshness window (e.g. 2 s). **Upgrade path if the threat model later admits an in-tunnel adversary:** a per-session *symmetric* HMAC over each batch, keyed by a stream secret delivered in the signed arm response (Slice 2) — never per-frame Ed25519.\n\n### Rate/DoS bounds\n- Cap batch rate (drop-to-latest, mirroring `camera_stream.py`'s \"inference never queues behind a slow frame\").\n- Enforce shape: exactly 21 landmarks/hand, ≤ 2 hands, floats sane/normalized; malformed → **honest empty** `[]` (the same posture as `OnnxHandLandmarker.detect` returning `[]`, never fabricated).\n- Bound raw payload size before JSON parse.\n- Source ends (StopIteration) when `session_id` no longer matches the live session (owner disarmed/expired) — the loop winds down naturally.\n\n### Plug point in `run_gesture` (zero change to the loop body)\nPaired components, both injected — the loop body `classifier.classify(landmarker.detect(frame))` is untouched:\n- `RemoteLandmarkSource.frames()` yields one token per received batch (blocks on the bridge inbound queue), providing cadence.\n- `RemoteLandmarker(source)` implements `components.LandmarkModel`: `detect(token)` returns the `List[Hand]` that token carries, **ignoring any image**. `egresses = False` (see Slice 3), plus an explicit `source_kind = \"remote_device_stream\"` provenance marker so it is never conflated with a local camera landmarker.\n\nInvocation: `run_gesture(source=RemoteLandmarkSource(...), landmarker=RemoteLandmarker(...), classifier=RuleClassifier(), gate=<armed gate>)`. Note `run.py` line 33 auto-owner-arms; the remote path must NOT auto-owner-arm — add an `auto_arm: bool = True` param (or accept an already-armed gate) so Step 3 (stream into a LOCAL owner-armed session) keeps auto-arm and Step 5 (device-armed) passes `auto_arm=False` and arms via `arm_by_device`.\n\n**Invariants preserved:** WARDEN/session gate stays downstream and untouched; landmarks into an unarmed session inject nothing (structurally, `session.py` 95-96); no new injection authority is introduced — only a new Hand *source*.\n**Adversarial lenses:** malformed/oversized batch → honest empty; replayed/reordered batch → dropped by seq; batch for a stale/foreign session_id → dropped; flood → rate cap; unarmed-session stream → zero injection (negative control test).\n\n---\n\n## Slice 2 — Device-signed remote arm in `SessionGate` (B) — HIGHEST RISK\n\n**Files:** `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/gesture/session.py` (new `arm_by_device`), `/home/kali/sigil/sigil/bridge/daemon.py` (new `arm_by_device` endpoint wrapping it), phone-side signer mirroring `mesh.registry.DeviceApprover` (a `DeviceArmRequest` helper, co-located in `mesh/registry.py` or `gesture/remote.py`).\n\nThis is a second application of the pattern in `BridgeDaemon.submit_device_approval` (daemon.py 47-65). Do **not** invent new crypto.\n\n### New method: `SessionGate.arm_by_device(signed_request) -> Session`\nThe phone signs an arm-request core with its **device** key and ships it in the bridge envelope:\n\n```\ncore = { \"signal\": \"gesture.arm_request\", \"device_id\": <id>,\n         \"nonce\": <random hex>, \"ts\": <float>, \"ttl_seconds\": <requested> }\nrequest = { **core, \"sig\": <device sig over core>, \"pubkey\": <device pubkey> }\n```\n\nVerification order (fail-closed, each step a documented gate):\n1. **Kill-switch first.** `KillSwitch(store).is_engaged()` → refuse. Owner halt (incl. `BridgeDaemon.panic_engage` from the phone) beats any valid arm.\n2. **Owner-minted device key only (RP-APPROVAL-2).** `pubkey ∈ authorized_devices(store, trusted_owner_pubkey)` AND `verify_signed(request, _ARM_CORE, ...)`-style signature check against that device key.
